purpose: Reconstruct the exact earlier uncommitted verification guards from an isolated current source copy.

patch.direction: Previous guards to current guards; reverse to reconstruct the previous guards.

compiled_inputs.current_map_derivation: Replace only the two previous guard hashes below in the previous 54-entry map with their current hashes.
compiled_inputs.manifest_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(path_to_sha256, sort_keys=True), using Python's default separators and no trailing newline.

reconstruction: Work only in an isolated copy matching the current compiled-input map.
Verify both current guard hashes before applying the patch.
Verify both previous guard hashes after applying the patch. The other 52 map entries remain unchanged, giving the previous manifest.
scope: Only Python verification process ownership changes. No Rust source or mathematical proof component is changed or retargeted. This records source reconstruction, not a new proof run.
